title.zh: Blast宣布关停L2主网，因维护成本超过收入
title.en: Blast announces shutdown of its L2 mainnet as maintenance costs exceed revenue

current_state.zh: Blast 因维护成本超过收入而停止运营，常规提现界面已于 10 月 26 日截止；桥上仍有约 4041 万美元资产，用户需通过直接与以太坊桥接合约交互手动提现；Bithumb 与 Upbit 已将 BLAST 列入交易注意名单并暂停充值；Upbit 进一步宣布将下架 BLAST，并将在当地时间 10 月 26 日 12:00 下架 BLAST 现货交易，相关网络转换期间暂停提现；Coinbase 要求用户在 10 月 26 日前将 BLAST 转出，并据报道于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易。
current_state.en: Blast is ceasing operations because maintenance costs exceed revenue, and the standard withdrawal interface deadline passed on Oct 26; about $40.41 million remains in the bridge, and users must withdraw manually by interacting directly with Ethereum bridge contracts. Bithumb and Upbit added BLAST to trading-caution watchlists and suspended deposits; Upbit has further announced it will delist BLAST and will delist BLAST spot trading on Oct. 26 at 12:00 local time, with withdrawals halted during the associated network conversion. Coinbase requires users to move BLAST off Coinbase by Oct. 26 and is reported to suspend BLAST trading on Oct. 20.

updates.what_changed_zh: 在 Blast 基金会宣布计划终止主网运营后，Bithumb 将 BLAST 列入交易警示名单并暂停充值，预计将在 10 月第三周决定是否下架。
updates.what_changed_en: Bithumb placed BLAST on its trading caution list and suspended deposits after the Blast Foundation announced plans to end mainnet operations, with a decision on delisting expected in the third week of October.
updates.current_state_zh: 在 Blast 基金会宣布计划终止主网运营后，Bithumb 将 BLAST 列入交易警示名单并暂停充值，预计将在 10 月第三周决定是否下架。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Bithumb placed BLAST on its trading caution list and suspended deposits after the Blast Foundation announced plans to end mainnet operations, with a decision on delisting expected in the third week of October.
updates.background_zh: Blast 曾是备受关注的以太坊 Layer 2 网络，链上资产规模一度超过20亿美元。该项目宣布因网络收入无法覆盖维护成本，将于本月晚些时候停止运营，CoinDesk 报道称其资产已下跌98%。Bithumb 是提供现货交易的韩国交易平台，交易注意名单是其在下架决定前使用的风险标记。
updates.background_en: Blast was once a closely watched Ethereum Layer 2 network holding more than $2 billion in crypto assets. It announced it is shutting down later this month because network revenue no longer covers maintenance costs, with CoinDesk reporting that its assets had plunged 98%. Bithumb is a Korean exchange offering spot trading, and a caution-list designation is its risk label ahead of a possible trading-support decision.
updates.market_impact_zh: BLAST 的可交易流动性集中于韩元现货交易对，充值暂停与注意名单指定直接压缩了持币者在这两家平台的交易渠道。Blast 主网停运计划与交易平台风险标记同时出现，也影响 Layer 2 板块代币情绪，不过该资产市值仅约2000万美元，规模较小。
updates.market_impact_en: BLAST's tradable liquidity is concentrated on Korean won spot pairs, so the deposit suspension and caution label directly narrow where holders can transact on those venues. The simultaneous wind-down of Blast mainnet and the exchange risk flags feed into sentiment across Layer 2 tokens, though the affected asset is small at roughly $20 million in market capitalization.

updates.title_zh: FN 速递丨Blast 宣布关停：吸金 22 亿，死于零造血
updates.title_en: FN 速递丨Blast 宣布关停：吸金 22 亿，死于零造血
updates.what_changed_zh:
由 NFT 交易市场 Blur 团队推出的以太坊 Layer 2 网络 Blast 宣布关停。其总锁仓量（TVL）已从巅峰约 22 亿美元跌至约 3200 万美元。

此次关停意味着 2024 年最受追捧的 Layer 2 项目之一正式落幕，用户需在截止期限前将剩余资金撤出该网络。

团队表示，该网络的运营成本高于其收入，且看不到弥合这一缺口的现实路径。有报道称用户须在 10 月 26 日前完成提款，而相关资金存放于由三名密钥持有者控制的合约中。
updates.what_changed_en: Blast has announced it is shutting down, with its total value locked collapsing from a peak of about $2.2 billion to roughly $32 million.

updates.background_zh: Blast 定位于以太坊 Layer 2，主打为 ETH 和稳定币提供原生收益，其卖点在于存款收益而非独立的应用生态。上线后其规模迅速扩张，一度成为 TVL 最大的 L2 之一，随后存款持续流出。TVL 衡量的是存入协议智能合约的加密资产总价值，本身并不代表盈利能力或真实用户质量。
updates.background_en: Blast was built as an Ethereum Layer 2 that offered native yield on ETH and stablecoins, positioning itself around returns for depositors rather than a distinct application ecosystem. It grew rapidly after launch and became one of the largest L2s by total value locked before deposits drained. TVL measures the combined value of crypto assets deposited into a protocol's smart contracts and does not by itself indicate profitability or user quality.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次关停通过情绪与流动性两条渠道对 Layer 2 板块形成压力：Blast 上的剩余存款需跨链撤回以太坊或其他网络，同时该事件也让市场关注 L2 网络能否以手续费收入覆盖运营成本。最直接受影响的，是仍持有 Blast 生态流动性的资产与场所，以及依赖 Blast 跨链桥的 DeFi 头寸。
updates.market_impact_en: The wind-down puts pressure on the Layer 2 segment through sentiment and liquidity: remaining Blast deposits must be bridged back to Ethereum or elsewhere, and the episode draws attention to whether L2 networks can cover their operating costs from fee revenue. Assets and venues most directly exposed are those still holding Blast-based liquidity and any DeFi positions dependent on Blast bridges.

updates.what_changed_zh: Coinbase 于 10 月 7 日发布状态更新，确认 Blast 网络正在被项目团队关停，并要求用户必须在 2026 年 10 月 26 日前将 BLAST 转出 Coinbase，否则网络关停后将无法访问这些资产；媒体报道称 Coinbase 将于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易。
updates.what_changed_en: Coinbase posted a status update on Oct 7 confirming the Blast network is being shut down by the project team and requiring users to move BLAST off Coinbase before Oct 26, 2026, or lose access after shutdown; media reports say Coinbase will suspend BLAST trading on Oct 20.
updates.current_state_zh: Blast 因维护成本超过收入而停止运营，用户需在 10 月 26 日前通过常规界面将资产撤回以太坊主网；提现等待时间计划缩短至 24 小时，但团队先退出其 Lido 资产，预计约一周内提现功能暂时不可用，截止后仍可通过以太坊 L1 上的 Blast Bridge 合约提取。Bithumb 与 Upbit 已将 BLAST 列入交易注意名单并暂停充值；Coinbase 发布状态更新，要求用户在 10 月 26 日前将 BLAST 转出，媒体报道其将于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易。
updates.current_state_en: Blast is ceasing operations because maintenance costs exceed revenue; users need to withdraw assets to Ethereum mainnet via the standard interface by Oct. 26; withdrawal wait time is planned to be shortened to 24 hours, but withdrawals are temporarily unavailable for about a week while Blast exits its Lido holdings, and after the deadline assets can still be withdrawn via the Blast Bridge contract on Ethereum L1. Bithumb and Upbit added BLAST to trading-caution watchlists and suspended deposits; Coinbase posted a status update requiring users to move BLAST off Coinbase by Oct. 26, with media reports that it will suspend BLAST trading on Oct. 20.
updates.detailed_summary_zh:
Coinbase 于 10 月 7 日 15:50（太平洋时间）发布状态更新，称 Blast 项目团队正在关停 Blast 网络，用户必须采取操作以避免失去资金访问权限。Coinbase 表示，若未在 2026 年 10 月 26 日之前将 BLAST 转出该交易所，网络关停后将无法再访问这些资产。

该通知把网络关停变成了对仍将 BLAST 存放在 Coinbase 的用户的硬性截止期限：2026 年 10 月 26 日之后，未转出的资产将无法访问。

Coinbase 将该条目标注为计划内维护，并表示将按需提供更新。有关此次关停的媒体报道称，Coinbase 将于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易，早于 10 月 26 日的提现截止日期。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
Coinbase posted a status update on October 7 (15:50 PDT) stating that the Blast project team is shutting down the Blast network and that users must act to avoid losing access to their funds. Coinbase said BLAST that is not moved off the exchange before October 26, 2026 will not be accessible to users after the network is shut down.

The notice turns the shutdown into a hard deadline for anyone still holding BLAST on Coinbase: assets left in place become inaccessible after October 26, 2026.

Coinbase labeled the entry as scheduled maintenance and said it would provide updates as necessary. Media reports on the shutdown state that Coinbase suspends BLAST trading on October 20, ahead of the October 26 withdrawal deadline.
updates.background_zh: Blast 是一条以太坊二层网络，在 2024 年 2 月主网上线时吸引了 23 亿美元存款，最初主打 ETH 与稳定币持仓的原生收益。有报道称，团队于 2026 年 10 月 2 日宣布逐步关停，理由是运营成本已超过二层网络收入，且看不到可信的经济可持续路径。
updates.background_en: Blast is an Ethereum layer-2 network that drew $2.3 billion in deposits by its February 2024 mainnet launch and initially pitched native yield on ETH and stablecoin holdings. Reports say the team announced the wind-down on October 2, 2026, citing operating costs that exceed L2 revenue with no credible path to economic sustainability.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径经由交易所托管与提现基础设施：存放在 Coinbase 的 BLAST 必须在截止日期前转出，随着网络关停，资金流将集中到该代币剩余的交易场所与提现通道。这也会影响市场对以太坊二层网络经济模型的情绪，不过此次关停属于有序退出，而非故障或漏洞事件。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through exchange custody and withdrawal infrastructure: BLAST held on Coinbase must be moved before the deadline, which concentrates flow into the token's remaining trading venues and withdrawal rails as the network winds down. It also feeds sentiment about the economics of Ethereum layer-2 networks, though the shutdown is an orderly sunset rather than a failure or exploit.
